system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity is attributable to pfupdater.exe running as leo.martins from the user-writable AppData\Roaming\PixelForge directory, rather than the approved inventory path under C:\Program Files\PixelForge.

The updater repeatedly connected to updates.pixelforge-suite.co; the inventory lists the approved updater check-in domain as updates.pixelforge-suite.com. The observed hostname differs by the missing final "m".
The connections occurred at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:36 through 14:06 UTC, and the last recorded attempt returned proxy status 502.
At 13:36, the running updater generated a file-creation event targeting its own executable path, which is unusual in combination with its user-writable location and the hostname mismatch.
The updater process ran at medium integrity as leo.martins, and telemetry records its termination shortly after the final failed connection.
Other activity includes ordinary-looking development-tool use and browsing during the window; that context does not establish that the updater activity is benign.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT metadata and byte counts for the updater connections, not the encrypted request or response contents.
The supplied records do not provide the updater binary's hash, signature status, contents, download origin, or reputation.
The evidence covers only the specified time window and does not establish what happened before or after it.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish what code the updater executable contains or whether it is definitively malware.
The evidence does not establish whether data was uploaded, what the connections exchanged beyond recorded byte counts, or whether any data was exfiltrated.
The evidence does not establish how the executable arrived on the host or whether it created persistence or caused other system changes.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and analyze the executable at C:\Users\leo.martins\AppData\Roaming\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe, including hash, signature validation, and comparison with a trusted vendor copy.
Obtain endpoint file provenance and related process, file, registry, and persistence telemetry for the updater before and after the review window.
Review proxy, DNS, TLS, and gateway records for the exact hostname, resolution, destination, and any available inspection or threat-intelligence data.
Confirm with the software owner or vendor whether updates.pixelforge-suite.co and this AppData-based updater are legitimate.
